definition_zh: 批评家；评论家；爱挑剔的人
definition_en: a person who judges and comments on works or on the actions of others
core_image: 一个人坐在台下，边看演出边在节目单上写满批注
scene: 演出还没结束，他就已经在节目单边缘写满批注。 The critic left before the final act.
sceneCN: 这里 critic 指「评论家」（第 1 个义项：公开评判艺术作品的人）；句意是那位评论家在最后一幕之前就离场了。

pos.zh: 批评家；评论家；爱挑剔的人

senses.title: A judge of art or writing
senses.definition: a person who judges books, films, music or art in public
senses.definitionCN: 公开评判书籍、电影、音乐或艺术的人
senses.example: The critic praised her first novel.
senses.exampleCN: 那位评论家称赞了她的第一部小说。
senses.why: Someone must tell the public what is worth its time.
senses.whyCN: 总得有人告诉公众，什么值得花时间。

senses.title: A person who finds faults
senses.definition: a person who says what is wrong with something
senses.definitionCN: 指出某事哪里不对的人
senses.example: He is a harsh critic of the new policy.
senses.exampleCN: 他是这项新政策的严厉批评者。
senses.why: The same judging eye can be turned on any plan.
senses.whyCN: 同一双评判的眼睛，也能转向任何计划。

intro.en: Critic comes from Greek kritikos, able to judge, from krinein, to judge.
intro.cn: critic 源自希腊语 kritikos（善于判断的），再往上是 krinein（判断）。

items.en: Krinein meant to separate, to decide or to judge.
items.cn: krinein 意为分开、决定或判断。

items.en: Kritikos described a person able to judge.
items.cn: kritikos 形容有能力判断的人。

items.en: Criticus named the judge of a text or a work.
items.cn: criticus 指评判文本或作品的人。

items.en: Critic named a learned judge of literature.
items.cn: critic 指博学的文学评判者。

items.en: It spread to art, music and the theatre.
items.cn: 它扩展到美术、音乐与戏剧。

items.en: It also means anyone who points out faults.
items.cn: 它也指任何指出缺点的人。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the crit- stem, and the meaning group names other people who comment in public.
note.cn: 形近组共享 crit- 词干，近义组列出其他公开发表评论的人。

entries.definition: judging, or extremely important
the act of judging faults
a careful written judgement
a person who writes about new works
a person who explains and judges events
a person who decides on worth or guilt

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a pencil in the dark and end with a sharp word at a meeting.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从黑暗里的一支笔开始，最后落到会上的一句尖话。

normal.en: Critic and crisis share a root: a judgement must be made.
normal.cn: critic 与 crisis 同根：总要有人做出判断。

normal.en: The critic watches the play twice and writes once.
normal.cn: 评论家看两遍戏，只写一遍字。

normal.en: Every margin is full of small marks.
normal.cn: 每一处页边都写满小记号。

normal.en: A good critic names the fault and the reason.
normal.cn: 好的批评者既指出毛病，也说出理由。

normal.en: Anyone can criticize; a critic is paid to be fair.
normal.cn: 谁都会批评，而评论家是靠公道吃饭的。

abstract.en: Picture a seat at the back of a dark theatre.
abstract.cn: 想象黑暗中剧院后排的一个座位。

abstract.en: Picture a page crowded with tiny notes.
abstract.cn: 想象一页挤满小字的批注。

abstract.en: Picture a raised eyebrow at a long meeting.
abstract.cn: 想象长会上一个挑起的眉毛。

examples.en: The critic called the film a masterpiece.
examples.cn: 这位评论家称这部电影是杰作。

examples.en: Critics of the plan want more evidence.
examples.cn: 这项计划的批评者想要更多证据。

examples.en: She became a food critic after ten years of cooking.
examples.cn: 做了十年菜之后，她成了美食评论家。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 critic 记成拿着小本子坐在台下的那个人：看完就写，写的就是评判。

root: 源自希腊语 kritikos（善于判断的），再往上是 krinein（分开、判断）；本义是「有能力评判的人」，后专指公开评论作品的人，也指爱挑毛病的人。

sensesIntro.en: From the public judge of art to anyone who names a fault.
sensesIntro.cn: 从公开评判艺术的人，到任何指出毛病的人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a pencil moving in the dark of a theatre.
core.cn: 核心意象：黑暗剧院里移动的一支铅笔。

branches.en: The critic turns a private evening into public opinion.
branches.cn: 评论家把一个私人夜晚变成公众意见。

branches.en: The same eye can be turned on a policy or a person.
branches.cn: 同一双眼睛也能转向一项政策或一个人。

branches.en: Both senses rest on the act of judging.
branches.cn: 两个义项都立在评判这一动作上。

branches.en: A review needs both knowledge and fairness.
branches.cn: 一篇评论既需要知识，也需要公道。

branches.en: A critic who never praises soon loses readers.
branches.cn: 从不称赞的批评者，很快会失去读者。

intro.en: Critic is the short stem word behind critical, criticism and critique.
intro.cn: critic 是那个短词干，critical、criticism 与 critique 都由它长出。

latinIntro.en: Greek krinein, to judge, became the Latin and English stem crit-.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语 krinein（判断）变成了拉丁语与英语里的词干 crit-。

items.example: The critic wrote three lines only.
items.exampleCN: 那位评论家只写了三行。

items.example: She gave the plan a critical look.
items.exampleCN: 她用评判的眼光看了看计划。

items.example: His criticism was short and fair.

items.meaning: a written judgement of a work
items.example: He wrote a critique of the design.
items.exampleCN: 他写了对这个设计的评论。
她带着判断读了这封信。
这位评论家说出了自己的标准。

latinEntries.example: Greek kritikos described a skilled judge.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 希腊语 kritikos 形容善于判断的人。

definition_zh: 度假胜地；手段；诉诸
definition_en: a place people go for holidays, or the use of something as a last option
core_image: 海边一排小屋，人们拖着行李来这里放松几天
scene: 旺季时这座海滨度假胜地挤满了来自北方的游客。 In high season the seaside resort is crowded with visitors from the north.
sceneCN: 这里 resort 是「度假胜地」（第 1 个义项：人们去度假的地方）；句意：旺季时这座海滨度假胜地挤满了来自北方的游客。

pos.zh: 度假胜地；手段；应急办法

senses.title: A place for holidays
senses.definition: a place where many people go to relax on holiday
senses.definitionCN: 许多人前往放松度假的地方
senses.example: The seaside resort is crowded in high season.
senses.exampleCN: 旺季时这座海滨度假胜地很拥挤。
senses.why: A resort is first a place people turn to for rest and pleasure.
senses.whyCN: resort 首先指人们为了休息和享乐而前往的地方。

senses.title: A last option or means
senses.definition: something used because no better option is available
senses.definitionCN: 因为没有更好选择而采用的办法
senses.example: As a last resort, we can walk home.
senses.exampleCN: 实在不行，我们可以走回家。
senses.why: The place one turns to becomes any resource one turns to in difficulty.
senses.whyCN: 所前往的地方，变成困难时所求助的任何手段。

senses.title: To turn to something for help
senses.definition: to use something, often reluctantly, because it is the only way left
senses.definitionCN: 因别无他法而使用某物，常带不情愿
senses.example: They had to resort to legal action.
senses.exampleCN: 他们不得不诉诸法律行动。
senses.why: The verb keeps the image of turning toward a place of help.
senses.whyCN: 动词保留「转向求助之处」的意象。

intro.en: Resort comes from Old French resort, a place resorted to, from resortir, to go back or go out again.
intro.cn: resort 来自古法语 resort（人们常去之处），源于 resortir（再出去、返回）。

items.en: Sortir means to go out.
items.cn: sortir 意为出去。

items.en: Resortir means to go back or come out again.
items.cn: resortir 意为返回、再出去。

items.en: Resort names a place people resort to.
items.cn: resort 指人们常去的地方。

items.en: Middle English resort means a place of assembly or help.
items.cn: 中古英语 resort 指聚集或求助之处。

items.en: Resort is used for places of holiday and pleasure.
items.cn: 到 16 世纪，resort 用于度假与游乐之地。

items.en: Modern English adds the phrase as a last resort.
items.cn: 现代英语增加了 as a last resort 这一说法。

note.en: Resort is a turning-to word, and it sits near its family and near words for destinations and options.
note.cn: resort 是一个「转向」词，与自身词族以及表示目的地和选择的词相邻。

entries.definition: third person form of resort
entries.definitionCN: resort 的第三人称单数形式

entries.definition: past form of resort
a person who often visits resorts
the place someone is travelling to
a choice available in a situation
a place of safety or help

normalIntro.en: Resort is a place one turns to: first a holiday place, then any last option.
normalIntro.cn: resort 是人转向的地方：先指度假地，再指任何最后手段。

normal.en: The verb resort to means turn to something for help.
normal.cn: 动词 resort to 意为求助于某物。

normal.en: A seaside resort is a place people travel to.
normal.cn: seaside resort 是人们前往的海滨度假地。

normal.en: As a last resort marks the final option.
normal.cn: as a last resort 标记最后的选择。

normal.en: The same word covers a place and a choice.
normal.cn: 同一个词既指地方，也指选择。

normal.en: Compare destination: destination is neutral, while resort suggests leisure.
normal.cn: 对比 destination：destination 中性，resort 带有休闲意味。

abstract.en: Picture suitcases rolling along a promenade.
abstract.cn: 想象行李箱沿着海滨步道滚动。

abstract.en: Imagine an empty road leading to the only open door.
abstract.cn: 想象一条空路通向唯一还开着的门。

abstract.en: Think of a hand reaching for the last tool in a box.
abstract.cn: 想象手伸向盒子里最后一件工具。

examples.en: The seaside resort is crowded in high season.
examples.cn: 旺季时这座海滨度假胜地很拥挤。

examples.en: As a last resort, we can walk home.
examples.cn: 实在不行，我们可以走回家。

examples.en: They had to resort to legal action.
examples.cn: 他们不得不诉诸法律行动。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re + sort」——再次出发去某个地方，先想到的是度假地，最后才当作手段；这只是拆词联想，与词源无关。

root: 古法语 sortir（出去）→ resortir（返回、再出去）→ resort（人们常去之处）→ 中古英语 resort → 现代英语 resort。

sensesIntro.en: The word begins with a place people travel to for rest, then becomes any option people turn to when nothing better remains.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词从人们前往休息的地方开始，再变成别无更好选择时所求助的任何手段。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a place people turn toward for rest or help.
core.cn: 核心意象：人们为了休息或求助而转向的地方。

branches.en: A holiday place is the most concrete sense.
branches.cn: 度假地，是最具体的义项。

branches.en: A last option is the place image turned abstract.
branches.cn: 最后手段，是「地方」意象的抽象化。

branches.en: The verb describes turning to that option.
branches.cn: 动词描述转向那个办法。

branches.en: People travel to a resort, and people turn to a last resort.
branches.cn: 人们前往度假地，也转向最后手段。

branches.en: The option and the act of using it are two sides of the same word.
branches.cn: 办法与使用办法的行为是同一个词的两面。

intro.en: Resort is a French noun and verb that English reshaped, and its small family grows with English endings.
intro.cn: resort 是经英语改造的法语名词兼动词，小词族由英语词尾扩展。

latinIntro.en: The French verb sortir means to go out, and resortir means to come back or go out again; the Latin prefix re- adds the return.
latinIntro.cn: 法语动词 sortir 意为出去，resortir 意为返回或再出去；拉丁前缀 re- 增添「返回」。

items.example: Re- adds the sense of returning.

items.meaning: to go back, come out again
items.example: Resortir joins the prefix and the verb.
items.exampleCN: resortir 把前缀与动词结合。

items.meaning: a holiday place or last option
items.example: Resort keeps both place and option senses.
items.exampleCN: resort 保留场所与办法两种含义。

items.example: Seaside resort is a common compound.
items.exampleCN: seaside resort 是常见复合词。

definition_zh: 成功；成功的人或事
definition_en: the achievement of what you wanted, or a person or thing that achieves it
core_image: 爬完最后一级台阶，把旗子插上山顶
scene: 她多年苦练，终于在全国比赛中获胜。 Her success came after years of practice.
sceneCN: 这里 success 是「成功」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她多年苦练，终于在全国比赛中获胜。

senses.title: Achievement
senses.definition: the fact of achieving what you have been trying to do
senses.definitionCN: 达成一直想做成的事
senses.example: Her success surprised everyone.
senses.exampleCN: 她的成功让所有人惊讶。
senses.why: This is the everyday sense of reaching a goal.
senses.whyCN: 这是达成目标的日常义项。

senses.title: A hit
senses.definition: a person or thing that achieves what is wanted
senses.definitionCN: 取得预期效果的人或事物
senses.example: The play was a great success.
senses.exampleCN: 这部戏大获成功。
senses.why: Here success names the thing that did well.
senses.whyCN: 这里 success 指表现优异的那件事物。

intro.en: Success comes from Latin words for coming after something.
intro.cn: success 来自拉丁语，本义是跟在后面、接续而来。

items.en: Cedere meant to go or to give way.
items.cn: cedere 意为走或让路。

items.en: Succedere meant to come after and take a place.
items.cn: succedere 意为随后而来并接替位置。

items.en: Successus was the noun for a good outcome.
items.cn: successus 是表示好结果的名词。

items.en: Succes meant a result or an outcome.
items.cn: succes 意为结果或结局。

items.en: Success came to mean a good result.
items.cn: success 逐渐指好的结果。

items.en: Success now means reaching a goal.
items.cn: 如今 success 指达成目标。

note.en: Success is compared with look-alike words and with words for good outcomes.
note.cn: 把 success 与形近词以及表示好结果的词作比较。

entries.definition: an amount that is too much
the right to use or enter
a series of steps
something done well through effort
a great victory
the state of doing well

normalIntro.en: Success is what is left after the work is done.
normalIntro.cn: success 就是苦干之后留下的结果。

normal.en: Her success surprised everyone.
normal.cn: 她的成功让所有人惊讶。

normal.en: The play was a great success.
normal.cn: 这部戏大获成功。

normal.en: Hard work is the key to success.
normal.cn: 努力是成功的关键。

normal.en: He worked hard for success in business.
normal.cn: 他为生意上的成功而努力。

normal.en: She told the story of her success.
normal.cn: 她讲述了自己成功的故事。

abstract.en: Success is a door that only opens from the inside.
abstract.cn: 成功是一扇只能从里面打开的门。

abstract.en: Real success is wanting what you already have.
abstract.cn: 真正的成功，是想要自己已经拥有的东西。

abstract.en: Success is the sum of small efforts repeated daily.
abstract.cn: 成功是每天重复的小努力累加而成。

examples.en: Her success surprised everyone.
examples.cn: 她的成功让所有人惊讶。

examples.en: The play was a great success.
examples.cn: 这部戏大获成功。

examples.en: Hard work is the key to success.
examples.cn: 努力是成功的关键。

dict_mnemonic.text: success 是「成功」，也可指「成功的人或事」；achieve success 是取得成功，the key to success 是成功的关键，successful 是成功的，successor 是继任者。

root: 来自拉丁语 successus，由 sub（在后）与 cedere（走）构成，字面是「跟在后面走上来」，由接替位置引申出顺利发展、取得成果。

sensesIntro.en: Success means reaching a goal, or the thing that reached it.
sensesIntro.cn: success 表示达成目标，或指达成目标的那个事物。

core.en: Arriving where you wanted to go.
core.cn: 抵达一直想去的地方。

branches.en: Her success surprised everyone.
branches.cn: 她的成功让所有人惊讶。

branches.en: The play was a great success.
branches.cn: 这部戏大获成功。

branches.en: A person and a play can both reach what was wanted.
branches.cn: 人和戏都可以达到预期的效果。

branches.en: Success in business grows from steady work.
branches.cn: 生意上的成功来自稳定的努力。

branches.en: The concert was counted a success.
branches.cn: 这场音乐会被认为是成功的。

intro.en: Success builds successful, successfully, and succession.
intro.cn: success 可构成 successful、successfully 和 succession。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base ced- meant to go.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根 ced- 意为走。

items.exampleCN: 团队庆祝了它的多次成功。

latinEntries.exampleCN: succedere 演变为英语的 succeed。
cedere 也演变为英语的 proceed。

definition_zh: 临时的；暂时的；短期的；非永久的；临时工（名词，常用复数）
definition_en: lasting only for a limited time; intended to be used or kept for a short period
core_image: 工地入口立着一块临时围挡，风一吹就晃，却已经立了三年
scene: 搬进新家前，他们先住进一间小公寓。 They stayed in a temporary flat while the new house was being painted, and moved out as soon as the work was finished.
sceneCN: 这里 temporary 是「临时的、暂时的」（第 1 个义项：只持续有限时间）；句意：新房刷漆期间他们住在一间临时公寓，一完工就搬走了。图中可辨识物件：简易公寓、纸箱、未拆封的家具、装修中的新房、搬家货车。

pos.zh: 临时工；临时事物（常用复数）

forms.label: 比较级（更多用 more 构成）

senses.title: Lasting a short time
senses.definition: lasting only for a limited period, not forever
senses.definitionCN: 只持续有限时段，不会永远
senses.example: They found temporary shelter under a bridge.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在桥下找到临时遮蔽。
senses.why: Temporary is defined by an end. It does not say how short the period is, only that a limit exists and is expected to arrive.
senses.whyCN: temporary 由“终点”定义。它不说时段多短，只说存在一个被预期会到来的界限。

senses.title: Not permanent
senses.definition: not intended to last or to be final
senses.definitionCN: 不打算长久保留或成为最终状态
senses.example: The agreement is temporary and will be reviewed.
senses.exampleCN: 该协议是暂时的，将会复审。
senses.why: The word often carries a promise or a warning: this state is provisional, so do not build your life on it, or do not despair of it.
senses.whyCN: 这个词常带承诺或警告：此状态是暂定的，故不要把生活建在其上，也别为它绝望。

senses.title: Of a short-term job
senses.definition: of work or a post that ends after a fixed period
senses.definitionCN: 有固定期限、到期即止的工作或职位
senses.example: She took a temporary job for the summer.
senses.exampleCN: 她做了份暑期临时工作。
senses.why: Labour markets use temporary as a category: the contract has an end date, and with it fewer rights and less security.
senses.whyCN: 劳动力市场把 temporary 当作类别：合同有终止日，随之而来的是更少的权利与保障。

senses.title: Of short-term lodging
senses.definition: of accommodation used until something permanent is available
senses.definitionCN: 在永久住处可用之前使用的住所
senses.example: The family stayed in temporary housing after the fire.
senses.exampleCN: 火灾后这家人住进临时住房。
senses.why: Housing makes the word concrete: a roof that is known to be borrowed, often provided by an agency or a friend, and marked by boxes not yet unpacked.
senses.whyCN: 住房把词变具体：一个明知是借来的屋顶，常由机构或朋友提供，以尚未拆封的纸箱为标志。

senses.title: A temporary worker (noun)
senses.definition: a person employed for a limited period, often through an agency
senses.definitionCN: 受雇有限期限的人，常经中介
senses.example: The hospital hired temporaries for the winter.
senses.exampleCN: 医院为冬季雇了临时工。
senses.why: The noun turns the adjective into a person. 'Temps' is the clipped, everyday form; the plural temporaries is more formal.
senses.whyCN: 名词把形容词变成人。口语缩略为 temp；复数 temporaries 更正式。

senses.title: A stopgap measure
senses.definition: an arrangement used to solve a problem until a better one is possible
senses.definitionCN: 在更好办法出现前用来解决问题的安排
senses.example: The ban is a temporary measure, not a policy.
senses.exampleCN: 该禁令是权宜之计，而非政策。
senses.why: A temporary measure admits its own inadequacy. It buys time, and the honest ones say so rather than pretending to be final.
senses.whyCN: 权宜之计承认自身不足。它买时间，诚实者会明说，而不假装是最终方案。

senses.title: A temporary file
senses.definition: a computer file created for a short task and deleted later
senses.definitionCN: 为短期任务创建、随后删除的计算机文件
senses.example: The installer left temporary files on the disk.
senses.exampleCN: 安装程序在磁盘上留下了临时文件。
senses.why: Computing literalises the word: the file exists only while a process runs, and its deletion is part of its design.
senses.whyCN: 计算把词字面化：文件只在进程运行时存在，其删除是设计的一部分。

senses.title: A short stay
senses.definition: a visit or residence lasting only a while
senses.definitionCN: 只持续一段时日的访问或居住
senses.example: He made a temporary stay in the city.
senses.exampleCN: 他在城里作短期停留。
senses.why: Travel and diplomacy use the word for presence that is explicitly not settlement. The visitor is in place but not of it.
senses.whyCN: 旅行与外交用该词指明确不落户的存在。访客在此地，却不属于此地。

senses.title: A passing setback
senses.definition: a difficulty expected to improve with time
senses.definitionCN: 预期随时间好转的困难
senses.example: The loss was a temporary setback, not a collapse.
senses.exampleCN: 这次亏损是暂时挫折，不是崩溃。
senses.why: Applied to feelings and fortunes, temporary is consolation: it reframes a present pain as a phase with an exit.
senses.whyCN: 用于情绪与境遇时，temporary 是安慰：它把当下的痛重新框定为有出口的阶段。

intro.en: Temporary comes from Latin temporarius, 'of a time, lasting for a time', from tempus 'time' (genitive temporis). English took it in the sixteenth century. The deeper origin of tempus is uncertain; it is often connected with a root meaning 'to stretch or span'.
intro.cn: temporary 出自拉丁语 temporarius“某段时间的、暂时的”，源于 tempus“时间”（属格 temporis）。英语十六世纪借入。tempus 的更早来源不确定，常与表示“伸展、跨度”的词根相连。

items.en: The adjective is first recorded in English in the sense 'lasting only for a time'.
items.cn: 该形容词最早记录于十六世纪四十年代，意为“只持续一段时间的”。

items.en: temporarius means 'of time, belonging to a time, transient', from tempus 'time, season'.
items.cn: temporarius 意为“时间的、属于某时段的、短暂的”，出自 tempus“时间、季节”。

items.en: tempus has the genitive temporis, which is why temporary has an r where the base word seems to lack one.
items.cn: tempus 的属格是 temporis，故 temporary 在词基看似没有 r 的地方出现了一个 r。

items.en: The Indo-European origin of tempus is disputed. A connection with a root meaning 'to stretch, span' is often proposed but not certain.
items.cn: tempus 的印欧来源有争议。常有人提出与表示“伸展、跨度”的词根相关，但并不确定。

items.en: Legal and religious writing spread the word: temporal goods are of this world, temporary arrangements last only a while.
items.cn: 十六世纪法律与宗教写作推广该词：temporal 之物属于此世，temporary 安排只维持一时。

items.en: Modern usage ranges from temp work and temporary housing to temporary files, all sharing an expected end point.
items.cn: 现代用法从临时工作、临时住房到临时文件，皆共享一个预期终点。

note.en: The first group is the tempus family, where r-forms and plain forms alternate; the second is words for shortness of duration, each with a different tone.
note.cn: 第一组是 tempus 词族，r 形式与无 r 形式交替；第二组是表示时短的其他词，语气各异。

entries.definition: for a limited time only.
the quality of lasting only a while.
relating to time, or to worldly rather than spiritual matters.
entries.definitionCN: 关于时间的；世俗的（非属灵的）。

entries.definition: lasting only a very short time and passing quickly. It is more literary and more absolute than temporary.
entries.definitionCN: 只持续极短时间并迅速消逝。比 temporary 更文学、更绝对。

entries.definition: used or done between two points in time, especially between two official arrangements.
entries.definitionCN: 在两个时点之间、尤在两个正式安排之间使用或做的。

entries.definition: arranged for the present but likely to be changed. It stresses conditionality rather than duration.
entries.definitionCN: 为当下安排但很可能被改。强调条件性而非时长。

normalIntro.en: Real links: tempus/temporis, the r in the English word, the temp-work sense, and the contrast with permanent.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联系：tempus 与 temporis、英语词中的 r、临时工作义，以及同 permanent 的对照。

normal.en: Tempus means time, and its genitive is temporis. That hidden r is why English has temporary.
normal.cn: tempus 意为时间，属格是 temporis。那个藏起来的 r 正是英语 temporary 的来源。

normal.en: Temporary is defined by an end: it does not say how short, only that a stop is expected.
normal.cn: temporary 由终点定义：它不说多短，只说预期会停。

normal.en: A temp job has an end date written into the contract; the word is a legal fact, not just a feeling.
normal.cn: 临时工作的合同里写着终止日；这个词是法律事实，不只是感觉。

normal.en: A temporary file exists only while a process runs; deleting it is part of its design.
normal.cn: 临时文件只在进程运行时存在；删除它是设计的一部分。

normal.en: Temporary vs permanent: one expects an exit, the other expects to remain.
normal.cn: temporary 与 permanent：前者预期出口，后者预期留下。

abstract.en: The temporary is not less real; it is real with a clock attached.
abstract.cn: 临时之物并非不那么真实；它是被系上时钟的真实。

abstract.en: Calling something temporary is a political act: it can make an injustice easier to bear or harder to oppose.
abstract.cn: 把某物称为临时，是一种政治行为：它能让不义更易忍受，也能让它更难被反对。

abstract.en: All arrangements are temporary at some scale; the word only makes the scale visible.
abstract.cn: 一切安排在某个尺度上都是临时的；这个词只是让尺度显现。

examples.en: The museum is closed for temporary repairs.
examples.cn: 博物馆因临时维修闭馆。

examples.en: He took a temporary position at the bank.
examples.cn: 他在银行做了一份临时职位。

examples.en: The decline in sales proved temporary.
examples.cn: 销售下滑被证明是暂时的。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses of temporary, all marked by an expected end. The end may be a date on a contract, the completion of a house, the closing of a file, or the passing of a mood.
sensesIntro.cn: temporary 的九个义项都以“预期终点”为标记。终点可以是合同日期、房子装完、文件关闭，或情绪过去。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a temporary fence that is expected to come down.
core.cn: 核心意象：一道预期会被拆掉的临时围挡。

branches.en: DURATION: the word measures a limited span and denies permanence.
branches.cn: 时长：衡量有限跨度，并否认永久。

branches.en: LIFE ARRANGEMENTS: jobs, housing, and the people who fill them are all marked by an end date.
branches.cn: 生活安排：工作、住房与填充其中的人，都带终止日。

branches.en: THE STOPGAP: measures and setbacks are framed as phases with an exit.
branches.cn: 权宜：措施与挫折被框定为有出口的阶段。

branches.en: COMPUTING: the file exists only while needed, and deletion is designed in.
branches.cn: 计算：文件只在需要时存在，删除是设计的一部分。

branches.en: PRESENCE: a short stay is presence without settlement.
branches.cn: 在场：短期停留是“在场而不落户”。

intro.en: Temporary is a Latin adjective in -arius built on the tempus/tempor- stem. English derives -ly and -ness, while the same stem gives temporal, contemporary, tempo, and tempest.
intro.cn: temporary 是建于 tempus/tempor- 词干的拉丁 -arius 形容词。英语派生 -ly 与 -ness，同一词干给出 temporal、contemporary、tempo、tempest。

latinIntro.en: Latin tempus 'time' has the stem tempor-, which supplies temporarius 'lasting a time'. The family includes temporal (of time), contemporary (of the same time), and tempo (time in music). The ultimate origin of tempus is uncertain.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 tempus“时间”的词干为 tempor-，生成 temporarius“持续一段时间的”。词族含 temporal（时间的）、contemporary（同时代的）、tempo（音乐的时间）。tempus 的最终来源不确定。

definition_en: the reflexive form of they, used when the group both does and receives the action, also for emphasis, and for a single unknown person
core_image: 照镜子：做动作的人和被动作碰到的人是同一群
scene: 布景塌了，剧组的人手忙脚乱。 The cast built the stage props themselves, no professionals were hired.

senses.title: Reflexive: doer and receiver are the group

senses.why: Mirror grammar: the sentence turns the group around to face itself.
senses.whyCN: 镜像语法：句子把群体转回身面对自己。

senses.title: Emphatic: done without help
senses.titleCN: 亲自； themselves 用于强调
senses.definition: used after a noun or pronoun to stress that the group did it without help

intro.en: Themselves is a double old compound: the Norse dative them plus self with the plural ending -s. English built its whole reflexive family this way, selves made from self.
intro.cn: themselves 是双重古老复合：诺斯与格 them 加 self 再加复数词尾 -s。英语整个反身代词家族都如此构成，selves 由 self 变来。

items.en: Self was already a stressing word; old reflexives often used the plain object form instead.

items.en: The Norse dative them supplied the object half of the compound.
items.cn: 诺斯与格 them 提供了复合词的宾格半边。

items.en: Middle English produced himself, herself, ourselves, yourselves on the model of me, myself.
items.cn: 中古英语按 me, myself 的模式造出 himself、herself、ourselves、yourselves。

items.en: The compound themselves spread by analogy, replacing the shorter native forms.
items.cn: 复合式 themselves 类推扩散，取代了更短的本族形式。

items.en: Modern English fixed themselves for the plural and for the neutral singular, with themself emerging beside it.
items.cn: 现代英语固定 themselves 用于复数与中性单数，themself 在其旁萌生。

note.en: The first group is the reflexive family built the same way; the second sorts the nearby self words.

sceneCN: 这里 spray 是「喷洒」（第 1 个义项：把液体散成细滴）；句意为园丁给干涸的花圃喷水。图中可辨识物件：水管、水雾、花圃、彩虹。

pos.zh: 名词：喷雾；浪花；喷剂；一小簇花

derivatives.zh: 由动词加施动后缀构成，义为「喷雾器；喷洒者」

senses.title: Liquid in tiny flying drops
senses.definition: masses of very small drops of liquid carried in the air
senses.definitionCN: 悬浮在空中的大量细小液滴
senses.example: The sea spray reached the cliff path.
senses.exampleCN: 海浪的飞沫溅到了崖边小径。
senses.why: One stream is broken into a thousand wings: liquid learns to fly.
senses.whyCN: 一股水流折成千只翅膀：液体学会了飞。

senses.title: To scatter liquid in drops
senses.definition: to force liquid through a small hole so it falls as drops
senses.definitionCN: 使液体经小孔喷出成滴
senses.example: Farmers sprayed the orchard before dawn.
senses.exampleCN: 果农天亮前给果园喷了药。
senses.why: A squeezed mouth turns one river into rain.
senses.whyCN: 捏扁的管口把一条河变成雨。

senses.title: A container of liquid for spraying
senses.definition: a container that sends out liquid as a fine mist
senses.definitionCN: 喷出细雾的容器
senses.example: She keeps a spray of lavender water by the bed.
senses.exampleCN: 她床头放着一瓶薰衣草水喷雾。
senses.why: The machine bottles the rain for one squeeze of a finger.
senses.whyCN: 机器把雨水装瓶，只待指尖一按。

senses.title: A small cluster of flowers or gems
senses.definition: a small branch with flowers or leaves, or gems arranged like one
senses.definitionCN: 带花的细枝，或仿此镶饰的珠宝
senses.example: The bride wore a spray of white orchids.
senses.exampleCN: 新娘佩戴一簇白兰花。
senses.why: The flying drops freeze into a bouquet's shape.
senses.whyCN: 飞散的水滴凝成花束的形状。

senses.title: To wet with flying drops
senses.definition: to cover something with flying drops or splashes
senses.definitionCN: 以飞沫或泼溅覆盖某物
senses.example: The passing bus sprayed mud over the fence.
senses.exampleCN: 驶过的公交车把泥浆溅上围栏。
senses.why: What flies from the wheel must land somewhere.
senses.whyCN: 从车轮飞出的东西终要落地。

senses.title: To direct a stream of shots
senses.definition: to fire bullets over a wide area
senses.definitionCN: 向大片区域射击
senses.example: The guards sprayed the fence line with gunfire.
senses.exampleCN: 守卫朝围栏一线扫射。
senses.why: Drops become bullets: many small strikes instead of one big one.
senses.whyCN: 水滴变成子弹：以许多小打击替代一次大打击。

senses.title: Spray paint or graffiti
senses.definition: paint applied through a pressurized can or gun
senses.definitionCN: 经压力罐或喷枪喷出的漆
senses.example: The wall was covered in spray paint overnight.
senses.exampleCN: 一夜之间墙面喷满了漆。
senses.why: Colour, too, can learn to fly in fine drops.
senses.whyCN: 色彩也能学会化作细滴飞行。

senses.title: A sprayer: the tool
senses.definition: a device or person that sends out spray
senses.definitionCN: 喷出雾的器具或人
senses.example: The old sprayer wheeled between the greenhouse rows.
senses.exampleCN: 旧喷雾器在温室行列间推行。
senses.why: The hand builds a metal mouth for the squeezed stream.
senses.whyCN: 手为捏扁的水流造了一副金属嘴。

intro.en: Spray is a northern word of flying drops, kin to the splash-family of the sea.
intro.cn: spray 是「飞沫」的北方词，与海的泼溅词族为亲。

items.en: *sprei- is generally reconstructed as "to scatter, sprinkle"; the deeper origin is source uncertain.
items.cn: 一般认为原始日耳曼语 *sprei- 表示「散布、洒」；更早来源不确定。

items.en: Middle Dutch spraye meant a twig or a scattered spray of water, the recorded bridge.
items.cn: 中古荷兰语 spraye 指细枝或散开的水花，是有记录的桥。

items.en: Some sources link Old English spræc and the noun spray of drops through the same Low German sea-words.
items.cn: 一些辞源通过低地德语海词把古英语形式与水沫名词相联。

items.en: The word settled in English in the sixteenth century for sea spray and twigs alike.
items.cn: 该词于十六世纪定型，兼指海沫与花枝。

items.en: Aerosol technology gave the word its modern bottle and its verb of choice.
items.cn: 气雾技术给这个词带来现代的喷雾瓶与常用动词。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers near spellings; the near-meaning group gathers words of scattering and drops.
note.cn: 形近组收拼写相近的词；近义组收表示散布与液滴的词。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the squeezed-hose image and the flower cluster the word also names.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子使用捏扁的水管意象，以及该词兼指的花簇。

normal.en: Sea spray is the ocean thrown into the air.
normal.cn: sea spray 是被抛上天的海。

normal.en: A spray of flowers is a branch that scattered like drops.
normal.cn: a spray of flowers 是像水滴一样散开的花枝。

normal.en: Hair spray holds a hairstyle the way mist holds on leaves.
normal.cn: hair spray 固定发型，如雾停在叶上。

normal.en: Spray paint flies through a nozzle, colour as fine rain.

abstract.en: Picture the fan of water catching light, a rainbow in the mist.

abstract.en: A thousand drops do the work of one river, gently.

examples.cn: 白色浪花在防波堤上炸开。

examples.en: The florist added a spray of baby's breath to the bouquet.

sensesIntro.en: The senses of spray all break one stream into many: flying drops, the bottle of them, the flower cluster, and the rain of bullets.
sensesIntro.cn: spray 的义项都把一股流折成许多：飞沫、喷雾瓶、花簇与弹雨。

branches.en: THE BOTTLE LINE: rain bottled for one finger-squeeze.
branches.cn: 瓶装线：雨水入瓶，只待一按。

branches.en: THE BLOOM LINE: scattered drops freeze into a bouquet.
branches.cn: 花朵线：散开的水滴凝成花束。

branches.en: THE BULLETS LINE: many small strikes replace one big one.
branches.cn: 弹雨线：以多次小打击替代一次大打击。

branches.en: THE PAINT LINE: colour learns to fly as fine rain.

definition_zh: 闲躺；懒洋洋地倚靠；懒散地混日子；休息室；客厅；机场候机厅
definition_en: to sit, lie or stand in a relaxed and lazy way; also a comfortable public room in a hotel, airport or house for waiting and relaxing
core_image: 一个人整个人陷进软椅里，胳膊搭在扶手上，一副哪儿也不想去的样子

sceneCN: 这里 lounge 是名词「休息室、候机厅」（第 4 个义项：供等候休息的公共房间）；句意为我们陷进机场休息室的软椅，终于放松下来。画面里可认出休息区、行李和沙发。

senses.title: To sit or lie in a relaxed, lazy way
senses.definition: to sit, lean or lie somewhere in a comfortable and lazy way
senses.definitionCN: 以舒服而懒散的姿势坐、靠或躺在某处
senses.example: He lounged on the sofa all afternoon with the television on.
senses.exampleCN: 他整个下午都懒洋洋地靠在沙发上，开着电视。
senses.why: The word was first used of slow, languid movement, so the core image of sinking comfortably into a seat naturally becomes the verb for lazy resting.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最早描写缓慢而慵懒的动作，核心意象是舒服地陷进座位，由此自然长出表示懒散休息的动词义。

senses.title: To stand or move about in an idle way
senses.titleCN: 懒散地闲逛；无所事事地消磨时间
senses.definition: to spend time in a place standing, leaning or walking about without any purpose
senses.definitionCN: 在某个地方站着、倚着或随便走走，没有明确目的，消磨时间
senses.example: A few young men lounged by the gate, waiting for nothing in particular.
senses.exampleCN: 几个年轻人懒散地倚在大门边，也不特意等什么。
senses.why: If the body is too relaxed to act with purpose, resting in a seat widens into drifting about a place, so the same lazy posture gives the idle sense.
senses.whyCN: 当身体懒散到没有行动目标时，坐着休息就扩展成在某个地方闲荡，同一副慵懒姿态便衍生出无所事事的意思。

senses.title: A comfortable sitting room in a house
senses.definition: a room in a house where people sit and relax, especially in British English
senses.definitionCN: 住宅里供人坐下休息的房间，尤见于英式英语
senses.example: The family watched the match together in the lounge.
senses.exampleCN: 一家人在客厅里一起看比赛。
senses.why: The room got its name from what people do there: since to lounge is to relax lazily, the room set aside for lounging became the lounge.
senses.whyCN: 这个房间因人们在那里的动作而得名：既然 lounge 是懒散地休息，专门用来休息的房间就成了 the lounge。

senses.title: A comfortable room for waiting in a public place
senses.definition: a comfortable room at an airport, station, hotel or club where people can wait or relax
senses.definitionCN: 机场、车站、旅馆或俱乐部里供人等候、放松的舒适房间
senses.example: They waited for their flight in the business lounge.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在商务候机厅里等航班。
senses.why: Waiting used to be done standing in a hall; giving waiters a soft room where they can lounge comfortably extends the home sense to public buildings.
senses.whyCN: 过去人们等候时只能站在大厅里；给等候者一间可以懒散放松的软房间，就把家庭义延伸到了公共建筑里。

senses.title: A room or bar for drinking and socialising
senses.definition: a room in a hotel, club or bar, often with music, where people drink and talk
senses.definitionCN: 旅馆、俱乐部或酒吧里常配音乐的房间，供人喝酒、聊天
senses.example: The band played quiet jazz in the cocktail lounge.
senses.exampleCN: 乐队在鸡尾酒廊里演奏轻柔的爵士乐。
senses.why: A room built for relaxing attracts drinks and conversation, so the waiting room sense drifts to the room where lounging happens over a drink.
senses.whyCN: 为放松而设的房间自然引来酒和聊天，于是等候室的意思偏向了那间一边喝一杯一边懒散度过的房间。

senses.title: A man's ordinary business suit
senses.definition: a man's usual matching jacket and trousers for business or formal daywear, in lounge suit
senses.definitionCN: lounge suit 里指男士平常穿的上衣西裤成套西服，用于商务或白天的正式场合
senses.example: The invitation asked gentlemen to wear a lounge suit.
senses.exampleCN: 请柬要求男士穿普通西服出席。
senses.why: Because a suit worn loosely at home was once contrasted with stiffer formal dress, the lazy word came to mark everyday formality rather than ease.
senses.whyCN: 由于在家松散穿用的西服曾与拘谨的礼服相对，这个表示懒散的词转而标记日常的正式装束，而不是指舒适本身。

senses.title: A man who idles in social places to impress others
senses.titleCN: 游手好闲的社交客（lounge lizard，旧式戏谑）
senses.definition: in the old informal phrase lounge lizard, a man who spends his time in lounges and hotels trying to impress people
senses.definitionCN: 旧式非正式说法 lounge lizard 里指常泡休息室与旅馆、装腔作势讨人喜欢的男人
senses.example: In the old novel, a lounge lizard occupied the hotel bar every evening.
senses.exampleCN: 在那本旧小说里，一个游手好闲的社交客每晚都占着旅馆酒吧。
senses.why: A person who only lounges about becomes a fixed type, so the lazy verb combines with a comic image to name the idle social climber.
senses.whyCN: 只会闲荡的人固化为一种人物类型，表示懒散的动词与滑稽意象组合，就用来称呼无所事事的社交客。

senses.title: Soft, relaxed popular music
senses.titleCN: 轻音乐风格的 lounge music
senses.definition: in lounge music, a style of quiet, easy-listening popular music played in bars and lounges
senses.definitionCN: lounge music 里指酒吧、酒廊常放的舒缓、放松的轻音乐风格
senses.example: The cafe plays lounge music all afternoon.
senses.exampleCN: 这家咖啡馆整个下午都放着轻音乐。
senses.why: The music takes its name from the place and mood it fits, so the room for lounging lends its name to sound made for lounging.
senses.whyCN: 这种音乐因适合的场所和心情而得名，供人懒散休息的房间便把名字借给了为懒散而作的声音。

intro.en: The origin of lounge is uncertain; it first appears in sixteenth-century English as a verb for lazy, slow movement, and several explanations compete.
intro.cn: lounge 的来源不确定；它最早见于十六世纪英语，作动词表示缓慢慵懒的动作，目前并存几种解释。

items.en: The verb lounge appears in the sixteenth century meaning to move or act lazily and slowly; no earlier ancestor is securely recorded.
items.cn: 动词 lounge 在十六世纪出现，意为懒散、缓慢地行动；没有可靠的更早祖先形式被记录下来。

items.en: A common suggestion links it to the older word lungis, meaning a slow, lazy person; this connection is generally held but not proven.
items.cn: 一种常见看法把它与更早的 lungis（慢性子、懒人）联系起来；这一关联被普遍接受但未获证实。

items.en: Some treat lounge as an expressive or imitative coinage for languid movement, like several other lazy-motion verbs; this remains a hypothesis.
items.cn: 也有人认为 lounge 是表达慵懒动作的拟声性造词，与其他几个表示懒散动作的动词相仿；这仍只是假说。

items.en: From the lazy action came a place where one lounges: by the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries the noun named a place to lounge, and later a room for it.
items.cn: 由懒散动作引申出可以懒散的场所：十六至十七世纪名词开始指可供闲躺的地方，后来指专门的房间。

items.en: Modern English keeps both sides: the verb for lazy resting and wandering, and the noun for sitting rooms, airport lounges, bars and soft music.
items.cn: 现代英语保留了两个方向：动词表示懒散休息与闲荡，名词表示客厅、机场候机厅、酒吧与轻音乐风格。

note.en: The look-alike group collects words with related shapes or sounds but different roots; the near-meaning group collects words for resting lazily or waiting comfortably.
note.cn: 形近组收拼写或发音相近但词源不同的词；近义组收表示慵懒休息或舒适等候的词。

entries.definition: A small sweet tablet, often for a cough.
entries.definitionCN: 润喉糖；含片。只是结尾拼写与 lounge 相近，词源不同。

entries.definition: Measuring a great distance, or to want something very much.
entries.definitionCN: 长的；渴望。与 lounge 有相似音段，但词源各自独立。

entries.definition: To become weak or to suffer for a long time.
entries.definitionCN: 变得衰弱；长期受苦。发音与 lounge 相近、语义有慵懒联想，但词源不同。

entries.definition: To lean back or lie down in a relaxed way.
entries.definitionCN: 向后靠；躺下，强调姿势而非懒散态度。

entries.definition: To stand or wait about idly, sometimes with nowhere to go.
entries.definitionCN: 闲逛；游荡，对应 lounge 的懒散闲待义。

entries.definition: A public room or passage where people can wait or meet.
entries.definitionCN: 大堂；门厅，与 lounge 的等候室义相对照。

normalIntro.en: Lounge hooks come from its lazy verb core and the rooms named after that laziness, so verbs and rooms reinforce each other.
normalIntro.cn: lounge 的记忆钩子来自懒散动词这个核心，以及因懒散而得名的各种房间，动词与房间互相印证。

normal.en: Lounge sounds like lounging body language: loose shoulders, sunk into a chair.
normal.cn: lounge 的发音让人想到懒散的肢体语言：肩膀松垮、整个人陷进椅子。

normal.en: Lounge about and lounge around are fixed verb phrases meaning to idle.
normal.cn: lounge about 与 lounge around 是固定短语，表示闲待着、无所事事。

normal.en: In British houses the lounge is the living room where the family relaxes.
normal.cn: 在英式住宅里，lounge 就是全家人放松的客厅。

normal.en: At airports the lounge is the waiting room, as in business lounge.
normal.cn: 在机场，lounge 指候机休息室，如 business lounge。

normal.en: The lounger is the person who lounges or the chair they lie on.
normal.cn: lounger 既指闲散的人，也指他们躺的躺椅。

abstract.en: The word pictures a body that has nowhere to be, so time itself feels soft.
abstract.cn: 这个词描绘一副无处可去、任由时间变得柔软的身体。

abstract.en: Rooms that host laziness borrow the name of the laziness, like the sofa lending its comfort to the room.
abstract.cn: 容纳慵懒的房间借走了慵懒的名字，仿佛沙发的舒适被搬进了房间。

abstract.en: Lounge holds both the verb of rest and the noun of place, joining action and setting in one sound.
abstract.cn: lounge 同时握着休息这个动作与场所这个名字，一个音节连起动作与场景。

examples.en: He lounged on the sofa all afternoon with the television on.
examples.cn: 他整个下午都懒洋洋地靠在沙发上，开着电视。

examples.en: They waited for their flight in the business lounge.
examples.cn: 他们在商务候机厅里等航班。

examples.en: The family watched the match together in the lounge.

branches.en: a family sofa facing the fire in a sitting room

latinIntro.en: Lounge is treated as a native or expressive English word, so no reliable Latin cognate is recorded for it.

definition_zh: 完全地；绝对地；确实；当然（表示完全同意）
definition_en: completely and without any limit, or used to agree strongly or to emphasize that something is true
core_image: 一个被拧到尽头的旋钮，没有中间档
scene: 朋友问她愿不愿意来帮忙搬家，她连一秒都没犹豫就点头。 When I asked if she would help, she said absolutely.
sceneCN: 这里 absolutely 是口语中表示完全同意（第 5 个义项：完全赞同）；句意为我问她愿不愿意帮忙，她说当然。

pos.zh: 完全地；绝对地；确实；当然

derivatives.zh: 本词的形容词形式，义为「绝对的；完全的；专制的」
由 absolute 加 -ness 构成，义为「绝对性；完全」
由 absolute 加 -ism 构成，义为「专制主义；绝对主义」

senses.title: To an extreme degree
senses.definition: used before an adjective to emphasize that a quality is present to an extreme degree
senses.definitionCN: 用于形容词前，强调某种性质达到极高程度
senses.example: The soup was absolutely delicious.
senses.exampleCN: 这汤好喝极了。
senses.why: Something absolute is complete; placed before an adjective, that completeness becomes the very top of a scale.
senses.whyCN: 绝对的东西是完整的；把它放到形容词前面，那种完整就变成了一把尺子的顶端，所以是「极其」。

senses.title: Completely, with nothing left out
senses.definition: entirely, so that no part is excluded or only partly affected
senses.definitionCN: 整体地，没有任何部分被排除或只受到部分影响
senses.example: The old bridge was absolutely destroyed by the flood.
senses.exampleCN: 那座老桥被洪水彻底冲毁了。
senses.why: The sense of being loosened from limits reappears here as nothing held back: the whole of the thing is affected.
senses.whyCN: 「从限制中松开」的意思在这里表现为「没有任何保留」：整个事物都受到了影响。

senses.title: With complete certainty
senses.definition: used with words such as certain or sure to mean that there is no doubt at all
senses.definitionCN: 与 certain、sure 等词连用，表示毫无疑义
senses.example: I am absolutely certain that I locked the door.
senses.exampleCN: 我十分确定自己锁了门。
senses.why: A judgement free from conditions admits no exception, so certainty hardens into absolute certainty.
senses.whyCN: 一个不受条件约束的判断不容许例外，于是「确定」被加固成「确定无疑」。

senses.title: Emphasizing that something is true
senses.definition: used to stress that what is being said is true, as in absolutely right
senses.definitionCN: 用于强调所说的话是真的，如 absolutely right
senses.example: You are absolutely right about the timetable.
senses.exampleCN: 关于时间表，你完全说得对。
senses.why: The adverb closes the door on any partly: a thing that is absolute cannot be only half true.
senses.whyCN: 这个副词堵住了「部分成立」的余地：绝对的东西不可能只对一半。

senses.title: Complete agreement in conversation
senses.definition: used alone as a reply to mean yes, very strongly, or I agree completely
senses.definitionCN: 单独用作答语，表示非常肯定地说「是」或「我完全同意」
senses.example: Would you like to come along? Absolutely!
senses.exampleCN: 你想一起来吗？当然！
senses.why: Agreeing completely is the conversational shape of an absolute judgement: no reservation is left.
senses.whyCN: 完全同意是「绝对判断」在对话里的形态：没有留下任何保留。

senses.title: Absolutely not: a flat refusal
senses.definition: in the phrase absolutely not, a firm and complete refusal
senses.definitionCN: 用于短语 absolutely not，表示坚决而彻底的拒绝
senses.example: Can I borrow the car tonight? Absolutely not.
senses.exampleCN: 今晚我能借用汽车吗？绝对不行。
senses.why: If yes can be absolute, so can no; the same emphasis serves refusal as well as agreement.
senses.whyCN: 既然「是」可以是绝对的，「不」也可以是；同一种强调既用于赞同，也用于拒绝。

senses.title: In an unlimited or despotic way
senses.definition: in a way that has no legal or practical limit, as of a ruler who governs absolutely
senses.definitionCN: 指不受法律或实际限制地，如君主专制地统治
senses.example: The dynasty ruled absolutely for almost three hundred years.
senses.exampleCN: 这个王朝专制统治了近三百年。
senses.why: The oldest Latin sense survives here without metaphor: power that has been loosened from every check.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的拉丁义项在这里不加比喻地保留下来：权力已经从一切制约中松开。

senses.title: Unconditionally, in legal use
senses.definition: in law, granted or held with no condition attached and no limit in time
senses.definitionCN: 在法律中，指授予或持有时不附带条件、也不受时间限制
senses.example: The land was granted to the family absolutely.
senses.exampleCN: 这块土地被无条件地授予了这个家族。
senses.why: Law keeps the technical core of the word: a title held absolutely is one freed from conditions and reversals.
senses.whyCN: 法律保留了这个词的技术核心：绝对保有的所有权，就是从条件与追夺中解放出来的所有权。

intro.en: Absolutely is the adjective absolute with the ordinary English adverb ending, and its history is the history of that Latin participle.
intro.cn: absolutely 是形容词 absolute 加上英语常见副词词尾，它的历史就是那个拉丁分词的历史。

items.en: Solvere meant to loosen or untie; English solve and solution descend from it.
items.cn: solvere 意为「松开、解开」，英语 solve 与 solution 都源自它。

items.en: Absolvere, from ab- plus solvere, gave the participle absolutus, meaning loosened, complete or unrestricted.
items.cn: ab- 加 solvere 构成 absolvere，其过去分词 absolutus 意为「被松开的、完整的、不受限制的」。

items.en: Old French absolut passed the adjective into English, where it kept the sense of complete and unconditional.
items.cn: 古法语 absolut 把这个形容词带入英语，保留了「完整、无条件」的意思。

items.en: The adverb was formed by adding -ly to absolute; both words are recorded in English in the late Middle Ages.
items.cn: 副词由 absolute 加 -ly 构成；两个词在中世纪晚期都已见于英语。

items.en: Use as a one-word agreement is a modern conversational development; the older senses concern degree, certainty, power and law.
items.cn: 单独用作答语表示同意是较晚出现的口语发展；较早的义项涉及程度、确定性、权力与法律。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the absolute family; the near-meaning group holds adverbs of completeness and of certainty.
note.cn: 形近组收 absolute 这一族词；近义组收表示「完全」与「确定」的副词。

entries.definition: The adjective meaning complete or unconditional, from which the adverb is formed.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「完全的、无条件的」，副词正是由它构成。

entries.definition: The noun for the quality of being complete or unlimited.
The political system in which one ruler holds unlimited power.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「专制主义、绝对主义」。

entries.definition: To declare someone free of blame, from the same Latin absolvere.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「赦免、宣告无罪」，与 absolute 同出拉丁语 absolvere。

entries.definition: In every part; it stresses wholeness rather than emphasis or agreement.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「完全地」，强调完整，而不含强调或赞同的语气。

entries.definition: Entirely; close in meaning but more informal in speech.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「完全地」，意思接近，但口语色彩更强。

entries.definition: Completely, usually with a strong or negative word.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「彻底地」，通常与强烈或负面的词连用。

entries.definition: Wholly; it often appears with words of agreement or difference.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「完全地」，常用于表示同意或差异的语境。

entries.definition: Used to agree or to say something is sure, without the force of absolutely.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「当然、肯定」，语气不如 absolutely 强。

normalIntro.en: The hooks work from the adjective absolute, its Latin core, and the fixed pairs the adverb appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面的联想从形容词 absolute、它的拉丁语核心，以及这个副词实际出现的固定搭配出发。

normal.en: Add -ly to absolute: the completeness becomes a way of acting.
normal.cn: 在 absolute 后加 -ly：那种「完整」变成了一种做事方式。

normal.en: ab- away plus solvere loosen: absolutely means with no limit left.
normal.cn: ab- 表「离开」，solvere 表「松开」：absolutely 就是没有留下任何限制。

normal.en: Absolutely right and absolutely certain are fixed, natural pairs.
normal.cn: absolutely right 与 absolutely certain 是固定而自然的搭配。

normal.en: One word as a reply, absolutely, means yes with no reservation.
normal.cn: 单独一个 absolutely 作回答，表示毫无保留的「是」。

normal.en: Absolutely not is the same force turned into refusal.
normal.cn: absolutely not 是把同样的力度转向拒绝。

abstract.en: Picture a dial with only one setting, all the way, and that is what absolutely adds to a word.
abstract.cn: 想象一个只有一个档位的旋钮，转到底，这正是 absolutely 给一个词加上的东西。

abstract.en: It does not soften and it does not hedge; it closes the space where partly could live.
abstract.cn: 它不软化、也不含糊；它把「部分」可能藏身的空间关上了。

abstract.en: The same word can say yes entirely or no entirely, because completeness has no direction.
abstract.cn: 同一个词可以说「完全是」，也可以说「完全不」，因为完整本身没有方向。

examples.en: The soup was absolutely delicious.
examples.cn: 这汤好喝极了。

examples.en: I am absolutely certain that I locked the door.
examples.cn: 我十分确定自己锁了门。

examples.en: Would you like to come along? Absolutely!
examples.cn: 你想一起来吗？当然！

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿布索卢特利」——旋钮一拧到底，不留余地：完全、绝对。

root: absolute 加副词后缀 -ly 构成；absolute 来自拉丁语 absolutus（absolvere 的过去分词），ab-「离开」+ solvere「松开」，字面义为「被松开、不受限制」，副词义即「完全地、无条件地」。

sensesIntro.en: Absolutely always means all the way: all the way up a scale, all of a thing, all of one's certainty, all of one's agreement or refusal, all of a ruler's power, or all of a legal title.
sensesIntro.cn: absolutely 始终表示「到底」：把一个尺度推到顶、把一件事做全、把确定性用满、把赞同或拒绝说到底、把权力用到没有边界、把产权给到无条件。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a dial pushed all the way to the end, with no setting in between.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个被拧到底的旋钮，中间没有别的档位。

branches.en: DEGREE: the top of a scale and the whole of a thing.
branches.cn: 程度线：尺子的顶端与事物的整体。

branches.en: TRUTH: certainty and emphasis that leave no room for partly.
branches.cn: 真实线：确定性，以及不给「部分」留余地的强调。

branches.en: CONVERSATION: full agreement and flat refusal.
branches.cn: 对话线：完全赞同与断然拒绝。

branches.en: POWER: ruling without any check.
branches.cn: 权力线：不受任何制约的统治。

branches.en: LAW: holding title with no condition attached.
branches.cn: 法律线：不附带任何条件的所有权。

intro.en: Absolutely is a Latin-rooted adjective plus the everyday adverb ending, so its parts are shared with hundreds of English words.
intro.cn: absolutely 是一个拉丁词根的形容词加上常见副词词尾，它各部分与成百上千个英语词共享。

latinIntro.en: The Latin verbs and participle behind the word are all recorded, so only the deeper root is a reconstruction.

items.example: Solvere is the core of the family.
items.exampleCN: solvere 是这一词族的核心。

definition_zh: 特征；特有的；典型的
definition_en: a quality that is typical of a person or thing, or being typical of a particular group
core_image: 一个人身上反复出现、可以辨认的记号
scene: 这种鸟的尾羽比身体长得多。 A long tail is characteristic of the male bird.
sceneCN: 这里 characteristic 指「特有的；典型的」（第 2 个义项：某类事物明显具有的）；句意是长尾是这种雄鸟的典型特征。

senses.title: A typical feature
senses.definition: a quality that is typical of a person or thing
senses.definitionCN: 某人或某物典型的品质
senses.example: Patience is her best characteristic.
senses.exampleCN: 耐心是她最突出的特点。
senses.why: The Greek adjective meant able to mark, so a characteristic is what marks a thing out.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语形容词意为能留下记号，因此特征是使某物得以辨识的记号。

senses.title: Typical of a group
senses.definition: being a typical quality of a particular person or thing
senses.definitionCN: 属于某人或某物典型性质的
senses.example: A long tail is characteristic of the male bird.
senses.exampleCN: 长尾是这种雄鸟的典型特征。
senses.why: The same adjective says that a mark belongs to a whole kind, not just one member.
senses.whyCN: 同一个形容词说明这个记号属于整个类别，而不只是某一个成员。

intro.en: Characteristic is the Greek adjective of marking, built on the same stem as character.
intro.cn: characteristic 是希腊语中表示「留下记号」的形容词，与 character 同词干。

items.en: Kharakter meant an engraved mark.
items.cn: 希腊语 kharakter 意为刻出的记号。

items.en: Kharakteristikos meant skilled at marking or distinctive.
items.cn: kharakteristikos 意为善于留下记号或有辨识度的。

items.en: Latin character and its adjective passed into scholarly use.
items.cn: 拉丁语 character 及其形容词进入学术用语。

items.en: English characteristic named a distinguishing quality.
items.cn: 十七世纪英语 characteristic 指有区分作用的品质。

items.en: The word now works as both a noun and an adjective.
items.cn: 如今该词既作名词也作形容词。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the character stem, while the meaning group lists feature words.
note.cn: 形近组共享 character 词干，近义组列出表示特征的词。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the mark root, the phrase be characteristic of and the noun ending -istic.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子利用记号词根、短语 be characteristic of 以及名词化词尾 -istic。

normal.en: Characteristic is the adjective of character, so it describes the mark a thing leaves.
normal.cn: characteristic 是 character 的形容词，因此描述事物留下的记号。

normal.en: Be characteristic of means the quality belongs to the whole kind.
normal.cn: be characteristic of 意为这种品质属于整个类别。

normal.en: A defining characteristic is the mark that decides identity.
normal.cn: a defining characteristic 是决定身份的那道记号。

normal.en: The adverb characteristically adds -ally to the same stem.
normal.cn: 副词 characteristically 是在同一词干后加 -ally。

normal.en: The plural characteristics names several marks at once.
normal.cn: 复数 characteristics 一次指出好几道记号。

abstract.en: Picture a bird with a tail far longer than its body.
abstract.cn: 想象一只尾巴远长于身体的鸟。

abstract.en: Picture a fingerprint that identifies one person only.
abstract.cn: 想象一枚只认出一个人的指纹。

abstract.en: Picture a list of family traits passed down the years.
abstract.cn: 想象一份代代相传的家族特征清单。

examples.en: The two species share several characteristics.
examples.cn: 这两个物种共有若干特征。

examples.en: Patience is characteristic of a good teacher.
examples.cn: 耐心是好老师的典型特征。

examples.en: Her style is characteristic of the period.
examples.cn: 她的风格是那个时期的典型风格。

dict_mnemonic.text: characteristic 是 character 加 -istic：一个人身上反复出现的记号，就是他的特征。

root: 源自希腊语 kharakteristikos（能留下记号的），与 character（刻痕）同词干，经拉丁语进入英语，指有辨识作用的品质。

sensesIntro.en: A mark that identifies a thing gives the noun a feature, and the same mark makes the adjective mean typical.
sensesIntro.cn: 辨识事物的记号给出名词「特征」，同一记号使形容词表示「典型的」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a mark that tells one kind from another.
core.cn: 核心意象：把一类事物与另一类区分开的记号。

branches.en: Patience as a characteristic is a repeated mark.
branches.cn: 作为特征的耐心是一道反复出现的记号。

branches.en: A long tail marks the whole male group.
branches.cn: 长尾标记出整个雄性群体。

branches.en: Physical characteristics are marks you can observe.
branches.cn: 身体特征是可以观察到的记号。

branches.en: The noun names the mark, the adjective says it fits the kind.
branches.cn: 名词指那道记号，形容词说它契合该类。

branches.en: Be characteristic of links one mark to a whole class.
branches.cn: be characteristic of 把一道记号连到整个类别。

intro.en: Characteristic adds -istic to the character stem, and the adverb adds -ally.
intro.cn: characteristic 在 character 词干后加 -istic，副词再加 -ally。

latinIntro.en: Greek kharakter and kharakteristikos are the mark and the marking adjective.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语 kharakter 与 kharakteristikos 分别是记号与「留下记号」的形容词。

items.example: The characteristic is easy to see.

definition_zh: 顺序；序列；连续；一段情节
definition_en: a set of things arranged one after another in an order

senses.title: Things arranged in an order
senses.definition: the order in which things follow one another
senses.definitionCN: 事物彼此相随的次序

senses.exampleCN: 把牌从小到大按顺序排好。
senses.why: The dominoes stand in one straight row.

senses.title: A set of numbers or symbols in order
senses.definition: a list of numbers or signs following a rule

senses.example: The sequence goes two, four, six, eight.

senses.why: Each domino carries the next number in the pattern.
senses.whyCN: 每张牌上都带着规律中的下一个数字。

senses.title: One event after another
senses.definition: a series of connected events or actions

senses.example: A strange sequence of delays ruined the trip.

intro.en: From Latin sequentia, a following, from sequi (to follow).
intro.cn: 来自拉丁语 sequentia「跟随」，源于 sequi（跟随）。

items.en: The root *sekw- means to follow, also seen in sequel.
items.cn: 词根 *sekw- 意为「跟随」，也见于 sequel（续篇）。

items.en: Sequi means to follow; sequentia is the state of following after.
items.cn: 拉丁语 sequi 意为跟随；sequentia 表示随后相随的状态。

items.en: Medieval scholars used sequentia for what follows in a text or rite.
items.cn: 中世纪学者用 sequentia 指文本或仪式中的后续部分。

items.en: Old French sequence carried both order and liturgical senses.
items.cn: 古法语 sequence 兼有次序与礼仪义。

items.en: English adopted it in the 1300s; modern use added math, film, and genes.
items.cn: 英语在十四世纪借入；现代用法又扩及数学、电影与基因。

note.en: Look-alikes in the sequ- family, and near rivals in the order field.
note.cn: sequ- 词族的形近词，以及「次序」义场的近义词。

definition_zh: 感激；感谢；欣赏；赏识；理解；意识到；增值；涨价
definition_en: to be grateful for something, to recognize the value or quality of something, to understand fully, or to rise in value
core_image: 把一件东西放上天平，认真称出它值多少
scene: 画展里，观众在一幅旧画前站了很久。 She stood before the painting and began to appreciate its quiet colours.
sceneCN: 这里 appreciate 是「欣赏；赏识」（第 2 个义项：认识到某物的价值与好处）；句意为「她站在画前，开始欣赏它沉静的色彩」。画面里有一幅旧画、驻足观看的观众与展厅的灯光。

pos.zh: 动词：感激；欣赏；理解；增值

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ation 构成，义为「感激；欣赏；理解；增值」
由本词加 -ative 构成，义为「感激的；有欣赏力的」
由本词加 -able 构成，义为「可观的；明显的」
由 de- 加同一词根构成，义为「贬值；贬低」

senses.title: To be grateful for something
senses.definition: to feel thankful for something someone has done
senses.definitionCN: 对别人所做之事心怀感谢
senses.example: I really appreciate your help with the move.
senses.exampleCN: 我非常感谢你帮我搬家。
senses.why: Latin appretiare meant to set a price on something; gratitude is a way of setting a high value on what was given.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 appretiare 意为给某物定价；感激就是给所受的给予估一个很高的价值。

senses.title: To recognize the worth of something
senses.definition: to recognize and enjoy the value or quality of something
senses.definitionCN: 认识到并享受某物的价值或品质
senses.example: She stood before the painting and began to appreciate its quiet colours.
senses.exampleCN: 她站在画前，开始欣赏它沉静的色彩。
senses.why: To appreciate art is to weigh its worth and find it great.
senses.whyCN: 欣赏艺术就是称量它的价值，并发现它很重。

senses.title: To understand fully
senses.definition: to understand fully how serious, important, or difficult something is
senses.definitionCN: 充分理解某事有多严重、重要或困难
senses.example: Few drivers appreciate how dangerous ice can be.
senses.exampleCN: 很少有司机真正意识到冰面有多危险。
senses.why: Full understanding is a correct valuation: seeing a thing at its true weight.
senses.whyCN: 充分理解是一种正确的估价：按它真正的分量来看待一件事。

senses.title: To rise in value
senses.definition: to increase in value or price over time
senses.definitionCN: 随时间推移价值或价格上升
senses.example: The old house has appreciated sharply in ten years.
senses.exampleCN: 这栋老房子在十年间大幅增值。
senses.why: Here the price is literal and it rises; the word returns to its money root.
senses.whyCN: 这里的价格是字面的，而且往上涨；这个词回到了它关于钱的词根。

intro.en: Appreciate is built on the Latin word for price, and every sense is some kind of weighing.
intro.cn: appreciate 建立在拉丁语的「价格」一词上，每个义项都是某种称量。

items.en: Pretium means 'price, value', and its deeper origin is source uncertain.
items.cn: pretium 意为「价格、价值」，它更早的来源存疑。

items.en: Ad- plus pretiare 'to price' produced appretiare, 'to set a value on'.
items.cn: ad- 与 pretiare「定价」构成 appretiare，意为「给……估价」。

items.en: French apprécier carries both 'to value' and 'to be grateful for'.
items.cn: 法语 apprécier 同时带有「估价」与「感激」两层意思。

items.en: English appreciate arrives in the sixteenth century with the sense of valuing or estimating.
items.cn: 英语 appreciate 在十六世纪进入英语，带有估价、判断价值的意思。

items.en: The money sense 'rise in value' develops later and runs beside the moral senses.
items.cn: 「增值」这条关于钱的义项较晚出现，与那些关于品行的义项并行。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words on the price root; the near-meaning group gathers verbs of valuing and understanding.
note.cn: 形近组收建立在「价格」词根上的词；近义组收表示估价与理解的动词。

entries.definition: The noun for gratitude, enjoyment, or a rise in value.
entries.definitionCN: 由本词派生的名词，义为「感激、欣赏、增值」。

entries.definition: Showing gratitude or enjoying quality.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「感激的；有欣赏力的」。

entries.definition: Large enough to be noticed or measured.

entries.definition: To fall in value or to speak of something as worthless.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「贬值；贬低」，与 appreciate 反向。

entries.definition: To regard something as important or worthwhile.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「重视、珍视」，对应 appreciate 的赏识义。

entries.definition: To regard someone or something with respect and pleasure.
entries.definitionCN: 带着敬意与愉悦看待某人某物，比 appreciate 更偏情感。

entries.definition: To grasp the meaning or seriousness of something.
entries.definitionCN: 理解某事的含义或严重性，对应 appreciate 的理解义。

entries.definition: To keep and value something highly.
entries.definitionCN: 把某物珍藏并高度看重，情感比 appreciate 更浓。

normalIntro.en: These hooks all use the price root preci and the image of weighing worth.
normalIntro.cn: 下面的钩子都用「价格」词根 preci 与称量价值的意象。

normal.en: Preci means price: appreciate is to put a price on worth.
normal.cn: preci 意为价格：appreciate 就是给价值定个价。

normal.en: Thanking someone is pricing their kindness high.
normal.cn: 感谢别人，就是把他的好意估得很高。

normal.en: Enjoying a painting is weighing its quality.

normal.en: Understanding a danger is seeing its true weight.
normal.cn: 理解一种危险，就是看见它真实的分量。

normal.en: A house that appreciates literally gains price.
normal.cn: 增值的房子就是字面上涨了价。

abstract.en: The same scale measures kindness, beauty, danger and money.
abstract.cn: 同一架天平称量善意、美、危险与金钱。

abstract.en: Appreciation is always an act of seeing worth.
abstract.cn: 欣赏与感激，归根到底都是看见价值。

abstract.en: The word teaches that valuing is a kind of knowledge.
abstract.cn: 这个词告诉我们：懂得看重，本身也是一种认识。

examples.cn: 我非常感谢你帮我搬家。

examples.en: Few drivers appreciate how dangerous ice can be.

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿普瑞希埃特」——把东西放上天平，称出它值多少：感激；欣赏

root: appreciate 来自拉丁语 appretiare「给……估价」，该动词由 ad- 与 pretium「价格、价值」构成，pretium 更早的来源存疑。经法语 apprécier 进入英语后，这个词始终在做同一件事：称量价值。给别人的帮助称出很高的价值，就是感激；给一件作品称出很高的价值，就是欣赏；把危险按真实分量称出来，就是理解；而价格本身往上走，就是增值。

sensesIntro.en: Four uses all weigh worth: gratitude prices kindness high, appreciation prices beauty high, understanding sees true weight, and rising value is literal price.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个用法都在称量价值：感激把善意估高，欣赏把美估高，理解看见真实分量，而增值则是字面上的价格上升。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a pair of scales with a thing on one side and its worth on the other.
core.cn: 核心意象：一架天平，一边放东西，另一边放它的价值。

branches.en: THE GRATITUDE LINE: kindness is priced high.
branches.cn: 感激线：别人的善意被估得很高。

branches.en: THE BEAUTY LINE: quality is weighed and enjoyed.
branches.cn: 美感线：品质被称量并被享受。

branches.en: THE KNOWLEDGE LINE: a danger is seen at its true weight.
branches.cn: 认识线：危险被按真实分量看见。

branches.en: THE MARKET LINE: the price itself goes up.
branches.cn: 市场线：价格本身往上走。

branches.en: THE MORAL LINE: both gratitude and taste are forms of valuing.
branches.cn: 品行线：感激与品味都是看重价值的方式。

latinIntro.en: The Latin layer is real: pretium 'price' lies inside appretiare.

definition_zh: 自动地；不假思索地；必然地
definition_en: in a way that works by itself, without thinking, or as a necessary result
core_image: 文件刚改完，云端自己打了一个勾
scene: 编辑文档时手一顿，标题栏已经显示保存完成。 The file saves automatically every minute.

pos.zh: 副词：自动地；不假思索地；必然地

senses.title: By machine, unaided
senses.definition: by a machine or system working without a person's action
senses.definitionCN: 由机器或系统在人不出手的情况下完成
senses.example: The file saves automatically every minute.
senses.exampleCN: 文件每分钟自动保存。
senses.why: The adverb describes the manner of the action: no hand is involved, because the mechanism supplies the movement.
senses.whyCN: 这个副词描述动作的方式：没有手参与，因为动作由机械装置提供。

senses.title: Without thinking
senses.definition: as an unthinking habit or reflex
senses.definitionCN: 作为不经思考的习惯或本能
senses.example: She automatically assumes the worst.
senses.exampleCN: 她总是想当然地往最坏处想。
senses.why: The machine image moves to the mind: a habit runs on its own, so the person reaches the conclusion with no deliberate step.
senses.whyCN: 机器的意象转到心里：习惯自行运转，于是人没有经过刻意的步骤就得出这个结论。

senses.title: As a sure result
senses.definition: as a result that must follow
senses.definitionCN: 作为必定随之出现的结果
senses.example: Prices automatically rise when supply falls.
senses.exampleCN: 供给下降时，价格必然上涨。
senses.why: When one change forces another with no alternative, the adverb marks that inevitability rather than any machine.
senses.whyCN: 当一个变化迫使另一个变化、别无选择时，这个副词标记的是那种必然性，而不是任何机器。

definition_zh: 熟悉的；常见的；精通的；亲密的；冒昧的

senses.title: Friendly

senses.title: Machine works alone
senses.definition: working by itself without a person operating it
senses.definitionCN: 不需要人操作就能自己运转的
senses.example: The doors are automatic, so you need not touch them.
senses.exampleCN: 这些门是自动的，不用手碰。
senses.why: Greek automatos described something acting of its own will, and machines took over that sense: the mechanism plays the role of the will.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 automatos 描述「按自己的意愿行动」，机器接过了这层意思：机械装置扮演了意愿的角色。

senses.title: Done without thinking
senses.definition: done as a habit or reflex, without conscious thought
senses.definitionCN: 作为习惯或本能做出，不经思考的
senses.example: Answering the phone is automatic for her.
senses.exampleCN: 接电话对她来说是不假思索的事。
senses.why: A person can also run on autopilot: the body acts by itself, so the machine word is applied to human habit.
senses.whyCN: 人也能靠「自动驾驶」运转：身体自己动起来，于是这个机器词被用到人的习惯上。

senses.title: Certain to follow
senses.definition: certain to happen as a natural result of something
senses.definitionCN: 作为某事的自然结果必然发生的
senses.example: A price cut means an automatic rise in sales.
senses.exampleCN: 降价必然带来销量上升。
senses.why: If a result follows a cause with no choice involved, it is automatic in the logical sense, like a machine that cannot do otherwise.
senses.whyCN: 如果结果毫无选择地跟着原因出现，它在逻辑意义上就是自动的，像一台不可能有别的动作的机器。

normal.cn: 副词形式加 -ally，变成 automatically。

normal.en: Do not confuse it with automated, which describes a process converted to machines.
normal.cn: 不要与 automated 混淆，后者描述被改成机器运作的流程。

abstract.en: See glass doors part before a hand can reach them.
abstract.cn: 想象玻璃门在手伸到之前就分开。

abstract.en: See a hand pick up a ringing phone with no thought.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手想都没想就接起响着的电话。

abstract.en: See one falling domino knock the next without choice.
abstract.cn: 想象一块倒下的骨牌毫无选择地撞倒下一块。

examples.en: The doors are automatic, so you need not touch them.
examples.cn: 这些门是自动的，不用手碰。

examples.en: Answering the phone is automatic for her.
examples.cn: 接电话对她来说是不假思索的事。

examples.en: A price cut means an automatic rise in sales.
examples.cn: 降价必然带来销量上升。

dict_mnemonic.text: auto（自己）加 -matic：机器自己动是自动，人不动脑就做是习惯，结果不由人挑就是必然。

root: 源自希腊语 automatos「自行动作的」，经 automaton「自动装置」与法语 automatique 进入英语；由机器自己运转，引申为人不假思索的习惯动作，再引申为必然出现的结果。

sensesIntro.en: A machine, a habit and a consequence can all be automatic.
sensesIntro.cn: 机器、习惯和后果，都可以是 automatic。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a door that opens before a hand touches it.
core.cn: 核心意象：手还没碰到，门已经开了。

branches.en: an automatic door
branches.cn: 自动门

branches.en: automatic transmission
branches.cn: 自动挡

branches.en: an automatic response
branches.cn: 本能反应

branches.en: almost automatic
branches.cn: 几乎是习惯性的

branches.en: an automatic result
branches.cn: 必然的结果

intro.en: The prefix auto-, 'self', builds automatic, automate and automation.
intro.cn: 前缀 auto- 意为「自己」，构成 automatic、automate 与 automation。

latinIntro.en: The root is Greek, so automatic belongs with Greek-made words like autonomy.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词根来自希腊语，所以 automatic 与 autonomy 这类希腊来源的词同属一族。

items.meaning: a self-moving machine or a lifeless actor
items.meaningCN: 自动装置；机械行事的人

items.meaning: a car or a self-working setting

definition_zh: 好奇的；奇怪的
definition_en: eager to know or learn, or strange enough to attract notice
core_image: 一只猫把头探进刚打开的纸箱
scene: 纸箱刚打开，猫立刻把头探了进去。 The children were curious about the old machine.
sceneCN: 这里 curious 指「好奇的」（第 1 个义项：急切想知道或了解的）；句意是孩子们对那台旧机器很好奇。

senses.title: Eager to know
senses.definition: wanting very much to know or learn something
senses.definitionCN: 非常想知道或了解某事的
senses.example: She was curious about the locked room.
senses.exampleCN: 她对那间锁着的房间很好奇。
senses.why: A closed door is a question standing up.
senses.whyCN: 一扇关着的门，就是一个立着的问题。

senses.title: Strange
senses.definition: unusual in a way that makes people notice
senses.definitionCN: 不寻常到引人注意的
senses.example: A curious smell came from the box.
senses.exampleCN: 箱子里传出一股奇怪的气味。
senses.why: What does not fit our pattern asks to be explained.
senses.whyCN: 不合我们套路的东西，会要求一个解释。

senses.title: Carefully made
senses.definition: made with care and skill, in older use
senses.definitionCN: 旧用法中指用心做成的
senses.example: The old clock is a curious piece of work.
senses.exampleCN: 这座旧钟是一件精细的作品。
senses.why: Care in making leaves a visible trace.
senses.whyCN: 制作时的用心会留下看得见的痕迹。

intro.en: Curious comes from Latin curiosus, careful and eager to know, from cura, care.
intro.cn: curious 源自拉丁语 curiosus（用心的、爱探究的），其根是 cura（关心）。

items.en: Cura meant care and attention.
items.cn: cura 意为关心与用心。

items.en: Curiosus meant full of care.
items.cn: curiosus 意为充满用心。

items.en: It then meant eager to know.
items.cn: 它后来指急于知道。

items.en: Curius kept the eager sense.
items.cn: curius 保留了急切这层意思。

items.en: Curious meant careful and skillful.
items.cn: curious 意为细心而有技艺的。

items.en: It settled into eager to know, and strange.
items.cn: 它固定为好奇的，也有奇怪的。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the cur- stem, and the meaning group names other words for wanting to know and for oddness.
note.cn: 形近组共享 cur- 词干，近义组列出其他表示想了解与古怪的说法。

entries.definition: the wish to know something
in a curious way
to make a sick person well
asking many questions
wanting to know more
strange and not usual

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a cat and a box and end with an old clock made by hand.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从猫与纸箱开始，落到一只手工做的旧钟。

normal.en: A curious mind treats every box as a door.
normal.cn: 好奇的心，把每个箱子都当成门。

normal.en: Cats are the picture of curious.
normal.cn: 猫就是好奇的样子。

normal.en: The same word means strange, because strangeness asks questions.
normal.cn: 同一个词也表示奇怪，因为古怪会引出问题。

normal.en: An old clock can be curious work, made with care.
normal.cn: 一只旧钟可以是一件精细的作品。

normal.en: Curious people learn faster and sleep less.
normal.cn: 好奇的人学得快，也睡得少。

abstract.en: Picture a cat with its head deep in a box.
abstract.cn: 想象一只猫把头埋进箱子里。

abstract.en: Picture a smell that makes you turn your head.
abstract.cn: 想象一股气味让你转过头。

abstract.en: Picture small gears fitted by a careful hand.
abstract.cn: 想象一只谨慎的手装好的小齿轮。

examples.en: The child was curious about the stars.
examples.cn: 这孩子对星星很好奇。

examples.en: I am curious to know how it ends.
examples.cn: 我很想知道结局。

examples.en: There was a curious mark on the wall.
examples.cn: 墙上有一个奇怪的痕迹。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 curious 记成「心里放不下」：cur 是关心，心里一直挂着，就变成了好奇。

root: 源自拉丁语 curiosus（用心的、爱探究的），其根是 cura（关心）；本义是用心，后指渴望知道，也指因少见而显得奇怪。

sensesIntro.en: From eager to know, to strange, to carefully made.
sensesIntro.cn: 从渴望知道，到奇怪，再到用心做成。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a cat pushing its head into a newly opened box.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只猫把头探进刚打开的纸箱。

branches.en: Something unknown pulls the mind toward it.
branches.cn: 未知的东西把心拉过去。

branches.en: A thing that does not fit is called curious too.
branches.cn: 不合套的东西，也叫奇怪的。

branches.en: Older speech used it for careful, fine work.
branches.cn: 较早的说法用它形容精细的活。

branches.en: The wish to know and the odd thing explain each other.
branches.cn: 想知道的愿望与古怪的东西彼此解释。

branches.en: Careful work and strange work both draw the eye.
branches.cn: 精细的活与古怪的活都招人看。

intro.en: Curious is the adjective that supports curiosity, curiously, and their compounds.
intro.cn: curious 是支撑 curiosity、curiously 及其合成词的形容词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin cura, care, is the root under curious and its whole family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 cura（关心）是 curious 及其整族词背后的根。

items.exampleCN: 毫无好奇心的头脑会错过很多。

items.example: The shelf held a small curio.

items.meaning: a shop selling odd old things
items.example: They met in a curiosity shop.
items.exampleCN: 他们在一家旧货店相遇。

items.example: Care can cure what drugs cannot.
items.exampleCN: 照料能治好药治不好的东西。

definition_zh: 轮胎；车胎（美式拼写为 tire）
definition_en: the thick rubber ring fitted around the wheel of a car, bicycle or other vehicle
core_image: 套在车轮外圈的一只厚橡胶环，接触地面的黑圈
scene: 暴雨刚停，修车师傅蹲在路边检查一辆车的黑胶轮圈。 The mechanic found a nail stuck in the front tyre.
sceneCN: 这里 tyre 是名词「轮胎」（第 1 个义项：套在车轮外的橡胶圈）；句意为修车师傅发现前轮的轮胎上扎着一枚钉子。

pos.zh: 名词：轮胎；车胎（英式拼写，美式为 tire）

collocations.zh: 备用轮胎；（俚语）腰间赘肉

derivatives.zh: 美式拼写的同词，义为「轮胎」；另有动词 tire「使疲倦」，两者词源不同
由本词加过去分词后缀构成，义为「装了某种轮胎的」，如 wide-tyred（宽胎的）

senses.title: The rubber ring on a wheel
senses.definition: the thick rubber band fitted around the rim of a vehicle wheel, filled with air or solid
senses.definitionCN: 套在车轮轮辋外的厚橡胶圈，可为充气式或实心
senses.example: Check the tyre pressure before a long drive.
senses.exampleCN: 长途驾驶前先检查胎压。
senses.why: The core image is the band that meets the road: everything the wheel feels passes through it.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是接触路面的那圈橡胶：车轮感受的一切都要经过它。

senses.title: A punctured or worn tyre
senses.definition: a tyre that has lost air or whose surface has worn out, needing repair or replacement
senses.definitionCN: 漏气或胎面磨耗到需修补更换的轮胎
senses.example: The flat tyre forced them to stop at the roadside.
senses.exampleCN: 瘪胎迫使他们停在路边。
senses.why: The band can fail: air escapes or the surface wears, and the wheel loses its cushion.
senses.whyCN: 这圈橡胶会失效：气跑了或胎面磨光，车轮失去缓冲。

senses.title: Spare tyre as the extra wheel
senses.definition: the extra tyre carried in a vehicle for use when one fails
senses.definitionCN: 车辆随车携带、供轮胎失效时替换的备用轮胎
senses.example: The spare tyre is under the boot floor.
senses.exampleCN: 备胎在行李箱底板下面。
senses.why: A copy of the band travels with the car, ready to take over the road contact.
senses.whyCN: 汽车的随行「替补圈」，随时准备接手与路面的接触。

senses.title: Spare tyre as waist fat
senses.definition: in informal British use, a roll of fat around a person's waist
senses.definitionCN: 英式口语中，指绕在腰间的一圈肥肉
senses.example: Years of desk work gave him a spare tyre.
senses.exampleCN: 多年伏案工作让他腰间长了一圈赘肉。
senses.why: The round band is imagined strapped around the middle of the body.
senses.whyCN: 把那只环状的圈想象成套在身体中段的带子。

senses.title: Tyre tracks as evidence of passage
senses.definition: the marks left on a surface by tyres, used to trace where a vehicle went
senses.definitionCN: 轮胎在地面留下的痕迹，用于追查车辆去向
senses.example: Fresh tyre tracks led down the muddy lane.
senses.exampleCN: 新鲜的轮胎印一直延伸到泥泞的小路深处。
senses.why: The band writes its pattern on the ground; the mark names the wheel that made it.
senses.whyCN: 橡胶圈在大地上印出花纹；痕迹替那只车轮署名。

senses.title: Racing tyre types
senses.definition: specially designed tyres for racing, weather or terrain, such as slicks or snow tyres
senses.definitionCN: 为竞速、气候或地形特制的轮胎，如光头胎或雪地胎
senses.example: The team switched to wet tyres as the rain began.
senses.exampleCN: 开始下雨后，车队换上了雨胎。
senses.why: The same band is engineered differently for each road condition.
senses.whyCN: 同一只圈针对不同路况被设计成不同形态。

senses.title: To tyre a vehicle (technical)
senses.titleCN: 给车辆装配轮胎（技术用法）
senses.definition: in technical or commercial use, to fit tyres to a vehicle or wheel
senses.definitionCN: 技术或商业用法，指为车辆或车轮装配轮胎
senses.example: The fleet was tyred with winter rubber before November.
senses.exampleCN: 十一月前整个车队都换装了冬季胎。
senses.why: The noun turns into a rare verb: putting the band onto the rim.
senses.whyCN: 名词转出少见的动词：把橡胶圈装上轮辋。

senses.title: Tyre as a cushion between vehicle and road
senses.definition: in engineering discussion, the tyre regarded as the layer that absorbs shocks and grips the road
senses.definitionCN: 工程讨论中，把轮胎视为吸收震动、抓附路面的功能层
senses.example: Modern tyres grip the wet road far better than old designs.
senses.exampleCN: 现代轮胎在湿滑路面上的抓地力远胜旧设计。
senses.why: Beyond being a ring, the band is the only contact point, so it carries grip and comfort.
senses.whyCN: 不只是个环，它是唯一的接地点，因此承担抓地与舒适。

intro.en: Tyre (British) and tire (American) share one history, but that history is genuinely tangled.
intro.cn: 英式 tyre 与美式 tire 共享同一段历史，而这段历史确实纠缠不清。

items.en: The verb tire is generally linked to Old French tirer 'to draw, pull'; the noun's earliest English sense was the iron hoop around a cart wheel.
items.cn: 动词 tire 一般与古法语 tirer「拉、拽」相关；该名词在英语中最早指套在车轮外的铁箍。

items.en: The wheel tire began as the metal band that 'dressed' or bound the wooden wheel.
items.cn: 车轮的 tire 起初是「束缚」或包箍木轮的金属圈。

items.en: When rubber replaced iron, the word transferred to the rubber band; both spellings tyre and tire were used.
items.cn: 橡胶取代铁箍后，词义转指橡胶圈；tyre 与 tire 两种拼法并行。

items.en: In the nineteenth century, British usage settled on tyre and American usage on tire; the split is conventional, not etymological.
items.cn: 十九世纪英式拼法定为 tyre，美式为 tire；这一分裂是约定俗成，并非词源差异。

items.en: The unrelated verb tire 'to fatigue' comes from Old English tēorian and is a different word altogether.
items.cn: 表示「使疲倦」的美式动词 tire 来自古英语 tēorian，完全是另一个词。

items.en: Today the hoop word is tyre in Britain and most Commonwealth countries, tire in North America.
items.cn: 如今「轮箍」一词在英国及多数英联邦国家拼作 tyre，在北美拼作 tire。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the spellings and the fatigue word; the near-meaning group gathers wheel and ring words.
note.cn: 形近组收各拼写变体与「疲倦」同形词；近义组收车轮与环状物词。

entries.definition: The American spelling of the wheel band; also a different verb meaning to fatigue.
entries.definitionCN: 美式拼法的「轮胎」；另有一个不相干的动词义「使疲倦」。

entries.definition: Fitted with a specified kind of tyre, as in wide-tyred; distinct from tired meaning sleepy.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，指装有某种轮胎的，如 wide-tyred；与表示困倦的 tired 不同。

entries.definition: Sleepy or fatigued, from the Old English verb tēorian; merely shares the sound with tyre.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「疲倦的」，出自古英语动词 tēorian，与 tyre 仅同音。

entries.definition: A row or level in a structure; spelled one letter differently and pronounced almost the same, but a different word.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「一排；一层」，拼写仅差一个字母、读音几乎相同，但属另一个词。

entries.definition: Formal clothing; built on the Old French tirer family that also gave the wheel band its name.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「服装、盛装」，与「轮箍」同出古法语 tirer 词族。

entries.definition: The whole rotating device; the tyre is only its outer band.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「车轮」，指整体；轮胎只是其外圈。

entries.definition: The metal circle the tyre fits onto; the tyre's partner part.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「轮辋」，是轮胎安装其上的金属圈。

entries.definition: A circular band; the historical ancestor's own family word for a binding ring.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「箍环」，正是历史前身「铁箍」的同族词。

entries.definition: The patterned surface of a tyre that grips the road.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「胎面花纹」，是轮胎上抓地的那层。

entries.definition: The air-filled tube inside older tyre designs.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，指旧式轮胎内部充气的内胎。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real drawing root and the phrases the word actually appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些记忆钩子使用真实的「拉拽」词根，以及这个词实际出现的常见搭配。

normal.en: The old wheel tire was a metal hoop drawn tight around the wheel.
normal.cn: 旧时的车轮 tire 是紧紧箍住轮子的金属圈。

normal.en: British tyre, American tire: same band, two spellings.
normal.cn: 英式 tyre、美式 tire：同一只圈，两种拼法。

normal.en: Tired drivers check tyres: the two words only sound alike.
normal.cn: 疲倦的司机也要检查轮胎：这两个词只是听起来像。

normal.en: Tyre pressure is checked with a gauge before every long trip.
normal.cn: 每次长途前都用胎压表检查胎压。

normal.en: Spare tyre means either the backup wheel or, as a joke, waist fat.
normal.cn: spare tyre 既指备胎，也是腰间赘肉的玩笑话。

abstract.en: Picture a black rubber bracelet gripping the road at one thin patch.
abstract.cn: 想象一只黑色橡胶手镯，以薄薄一小块紧贴路面。

abstract.en: The car never touches the earth directly; only the band does.
abstract.cn: 汽车从不直接触地；接触大地的只有那圈橡胶。

abstract.en: A worn band is a conversation with the road that has run out of words.
abstract.cn: 磨光的胎面就是一场与路面无话可说的对话。

examples.en: A nail in the left rear tyre left the car leaning to one side.
examples.cn: 左后轮扎了钉子，车身向一侧倾斜。

examples.en: Racing teams choose their tyres carefully for each track surface.
examples.cn: 赛车队针对每条赛道的路面仔细选择轮胎。

examples.en: He jacked up the car and changed the flat tyre in ten minutes.
examples.cn: 他架起千斤顶，十分钟就换好了瘪胎。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「太耳」——轮胎贴地，路面声音太吵到耳朵：轮胎

root: 轮箍义一般认为源自古法语 tirer「拉、拽」相关词形，最早指束缚木轮的金属箍；十九世纪橡胶取代铁箍后转指橡胶圈；英式拼法 tyre 与美式 tire 的分化属约定俗成；表示「疲倦」的动词 tire 出自古英语 tēorian，与轮箍义词源不同。

sensesIntro.en: The eight senses of tyre all belong to one road-going band: the ring itself, its failures, its spare, its comic double at the waist, the tracks it leaves, its racing variants, the act of fitting it, and its role as the car's only grip.
sensesIntro.cn: tyre 的八个义项都属于同一只行路之圈：圈本身、它的失效、备胎、腰间的滑稽翻版、它留下的车辙、竞速变体、装配动作，以及它作为车辆唯一抓地层的角色。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a black rubber band is the only part of the car that touches the road.
core.cn: 核心意象：黑色橡胶圈是全车唯一触地的部分。

branches.en: THE GRIP: the band engineered for the road, from everyday to racing rubber.
branches.cn: 抓地线：为路面而设计的橡胶圈，从日常到竞速。

branches.en: THE FAILURE: air lost or surface worn, the wheel loses its cushion.
branches.cn: 失效线：漏气或磨耗，车轮失去缓冲。

branches.en: THE DOUBLE: a spare band on board, and the joke copy around the waist.
branches.cn: 替补线：随车的备胎，以及腰间的滑稽翻版。

branches.en: THE SIGN: the ground remembers which band passed.
branches.cn: 痕迹线：大地记得哪只圈经过。

branches.en: THE FITTING: putting the band onto the rim.
branches.cn: 装配线：把橡胶圈装上轮辋。

intro.en: Tyre is a bare root word; its family lives in compounds and spellings rather than suffixes.
intro.cn: tyre 是一个裸词根；其词族主要体现在复合词与拼写变体上，而非后缀。

latinIntro.en: The word is French and Germanic in origin, so there are no Latin cognates to list; the Old French link is the generally accepted account.
latinIntro.cn: 该词源于法语与日耳曼语，故没有拉丁同族词可列；与古法语的关联是公认的说法。

items.example: The verb is the accepted starting point for the band word.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词是「轮箍」一词公认的起点。

items.example: It shares the Old French family.
items.exampleCN: 它与「轮箍」同出古法语词族。

items.example: It gives the unrelated tired and tire.

definition_en: to some degree but not completely, or used before a reason to say that it is only one of several causes

pos.zh: 部分地；不完全地；部分因为

derivatives.zh: partly 所由构成的词，义为「部分；角色」
